trigger: Morning. Loudspeakers. Ironwood quarantine sweep in Sector 4.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Late November. Sleet. A loudspeaker: TYPHOID QUARANTINE, SECTOR FOUR. REMAIN INDOORS. PREPARE FOR INSPECTION.

nodes.speaker: lolo
nodes.text: Typhoid. Ha. There are two cases and both are mine. They're looking for guns, maitia.

nodes.speaker: lolo
nodes.text: I have morphine in the clinic. The Pruitts have six months of food in the crawlspace. They'll take it all.

choices.text: Declare it. Don't give them a reason.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Ten minutes, two trips, Wraith on lookout at the corner. The crawlspace in your house is now very full.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You hide your own rifle and filters. Through the window, soldiers carry boxes out of the Pruitts'.

nodes.speaker: lolo
nodes.text: Declare it. Yes. And then they declare it theirs. You'll see.

nodes.speaker: ironwood_soldier
nodes.text: Open up! Sector four inspection! Restrain the dog!

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: They turn the house over. They miss the crawlspace. One of them pets Wraith on the way out.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: A soldier panics. A rifle butt. Wraith yelps and goes down limping. They leave faster than they came.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: WRAITH IS INJURED. She can't track until treated (vet_kit or rest). She still tries to stand guard.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Down the street, a list is taped to a lamppost. Names. Your street. Informants, it says.
